verdict.rationale: Ironclad's product pages confirm native e-signature ('Contract Signing Has Never Been Easier') and workflow/routing capabilities (Workflow Designer, launch-a-workflow API, approval/signature policies), which together imply routed multi-recipient signing. However, no evidence details signer ordering, multi-recipient CC/parallel-vs-sequential routing config, or hands-on confirmation that the signing step supports multiple recipients as described. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of multi-recipient signature routing/order options, and independent/hands-on validation of the signing flow.
